title: Evolution of Metal-Based Anticancer Therapeutics: Chemical Foundations, Platinum Drugs, and Emerging Schiff Base Ruthenium(II) and Iridium(III) Complexes.
one_liner_zh: 综述金属抗癌配合物（含Ru/Ir-Schiff碱）的化学基础与机制，涉及DNA结合但非TF-DNA互作体系，且方法仅提及分子对接/DFT而无AI或MD核心建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Metal-based chemotherapy has remained a cornerstone of cancer treatment since the clinical introduction of cisplatin; however, systemic toxicity, dose-limiting nephrotoxicity, and acquired resistance continue to limit its therapeutic efficacy. These challenges have stimulated the development of non-platinum-metal-based agents, particularly ruthenium-(II/III) and iridium-(III) complexes, which offer tunable coordination environments, redox adaptability, and diverse mechanisms of action. Among the ligand systems investigated, Schiff bases have emerged as versatile scaffolds capable of modulating complex stability, lipophilicity, and target selectivity. This Review critically examines recent advances (2023-2025) in Schiff base ruthenium and iridium complexes, with emphasis on their structure-activity relationships and anticancer mechanisms. Recent Schiff base Ru-(II/III) complexes have demonstrated promising DNA-binding, redox-modulating, and apoptosis-inducing properties, whereas several Ir-(III) complexes exhibit potent cytotoxicity, phosphorescence imaging capability, and phototherapeutic potential, supporting their development as theranostic agents. Mechanistic studies reveal multimodal activity involving DNA interactions, human serum albumin (HSA) binding, reactive oxygen species (ROS) modulation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and apoptosis induction. Emerging strategies, including NIR-activated phototherapy, nanocarrier-assisted delivery, and computational approaches such as molecular docking and density functional theory (DFT) calculations, are further highlighted as promising directions for the rational design of next-generation metal-based anticancer therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 金属基化疗自顺铂临床引入以来一直是癌症治疗的基石；然而，全身毒性、剂量限制性肾毒性和获得性耐药持续限制其疗效。这些挑战推动了非铂金属基药物的发展，特别是钌-(II/III)和铱-(III)配合物，它们具有可调的配位环境、氧化还原适应性和多样化的作用机制。在所研究的配体体系中，席夫碱已成为能够调节配合物稳定性、亲脂性和靶点选择性的多功能支架。本综述批判性地审视了2023-2025年间席夫碱钌和铱配合物的最新进展，重点强调其构效关系和抗癌机制。近期席夫碱Ru-(II/III)配合物已展现出有前景的DNA结合、氧化还原调节和凋亡诱导特性，而若干Ir-(III)配合物则表现出强效细胞毒性、磷光成像能力和光治疗潜力，支持其作为诊疗一体化药物的开发。机制研究揭示其多模式活性，涉及DNA相互作用、人血清白蛋白 (human serum albumin, HSA) 结合、活性氧 (reactive oxygen species, ROS) 调节、线粒体功能障碍和凋亡诱导。新兴策略，包括近红外激活光疗、纳米载体辅助递送，以及分子对接和密度泛函理论 (density functional theory, DFT) 计算等计算方法，被进一步强调为合理设计下一代金属基抗癌治疗药物的有前景方向。
